## SKIN INFORMATION

This skin was originally posted [online](https://danmuji2box.tistory.com/789) and was broken so I fixed it, created the white and blue & blue and green versions, and reuploaded it.
There are two versions of the skin available to download:

- Donkey Kong Nunu - Classic
- Base Nunu = Brown Fur + Red Accessories
- Sasquatch Nunu = White Fur + Blue Accessories
- Grungy Nunu = Blue Fur + Green Accessories
- Donkey Kong Nunu - Classic Alt
- Base Nunu = White Fur + Blue Accessories
- Sasquatch Nunu = Brown Fur + Red Accessories
- Grungy Nunu = Blue Fur + Green Accessories
